entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Charlie at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I need to process a return for an order I placed a couple of months ago. It's for a helmet.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Of course. The name is Alex Smith, and the order number is VF-8675309.
Thank you, Alex. I have your order right here. Before we proceed, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's just a preference. The color wasn't quite what I expected when I saw it in person. It's a great helmet, but it just doesn't match my gear. The box is still unopened, so it's in perfect condition.

I understand completely. Getting the right look is part of the experience. And more importantly, having a helmet you love encourages you to wear it, which is the top priority for safety. Let me just check the purchase date against our return policy.

Okay, Alex. I see the item was delivered 70 days ago. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, so you are well within the window. I've just approved the return for you. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label right now.

That's great news, thank you, Charlie. Now, since I'm going through the process of sending this back and I'll be ordering a different one, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase? Say, 10% for the inconvenience?

I appreciate you asking, Alex. While I can't offer a discount code, the good news is we are covering the full cost of the return shipping for you. Once we receive the helmet, you'll get a full refund to your original payment method.
I see. No discount, then? Not even for a loyal customer?

I'm afraid our system doesn't allow for goodwill credits on preference-based returns. Approving the full refund this far out from the purchase date and covering the shipping is the best I can do according to policy. I've just sent that label to the email on file.
Alright, that's fair enough. I had to try. Thanks for your help today, Charlie. You've made it easy.
You're very welcome, Alex. We want to make sure you have the right gear for your ride. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's all. Have a good one.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and happy holidays!
